name: テンプレート初期タスクと担当役割の編集表
prompt:
Recreate the supplied Asana project-template task editor as a faithful Japanese localization. Match the exact 841 by 670 pixel crop and 1.255:1 aspect ratio. Include only the central editor, with no left navigation or right customization panel.

Keep the main geometry of the first result and correct these measured controls and column positions. The project selector is approximately x=116, y=59, width=161, height=35. Use the compact label 「既定の表示：リスト」 with a list icon, small 13-pixel text, and compact padding so the pill remains about 161 pixels wide. The blue split button is approximately x=33, y=133, width=137, height=36; label it 「タスクを追加」 with a plus icon and a narrow separate dropdown segment. Keep its text around 14 pixels and use compact side padding. The task-table vertical divider begins the right assignee column at x=656; keep that position so the name column is about 653 pixels wide and the assignee column about 185 pixels wide.

At the top, preserve the white project header, 62-pixel soft-gray rounded-square project-board glyph at x=34,y=27, bold title 「プロジェクトキックオフ」 at x=116,y=27, and a thin divider at y=114. Below the control bar divider at y=187, show the two-column table with headers 「名前」 and 「担当者」. Rows are about 50 pixels high. Exactly three task rows: the first has pale-blue selected fill, an hourglass icon, 「プロジェクト概要を作成」, then the role icon and compact right-column label 「プロジェクト管理者」. The second has a circular check icon, 「計画書をチームに共有」, and a circular portrait with “Alex Smith”. The third has a circular check icon, 「キックオフミーティングを予定」, and the role icon with 「プロジェクト管理者」. Keep every assignee label fully inside the right edge. Follow with muted placeholder 「タスクを追加...」.

In the lower half, retain three spaced sections in this order: 「未着手」 with a right-pointing collapsed triangle; 「進行中」 with a down-pointing triangle; 「完了」 with a down-pointing triangle. At the bottom edge include the plus icon and 「セクションを追加」 row, slightly clipped as in the source.

Use compact Asana-like typography, dark charcoal text, subtle gray dividers, small monochrome status icons, white background, and restrained blue for the selected row and Add task button. Keep the same row heights and section spacing. Preserve all visible task names, assignees and states. Do not add tasks, columns, or content outside the crop.
reviewNotes: Version 2 fixes the clipped role labels and retains all three task names and section states. Needs correction after the two-attempt cap: Add Task remains about 30% wider than the source, and the assignee column divider remains about 19 pixels left of source x=656. Candidate 1405x1120 (1.2545:1) matches 841x670 (1.2552:1) within 0.1%; visual comparison complete.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
